name: context-sieve
description: A cheaper model filters large tool outputs down to what the current task needs before they enter the main model's context.

threshold.title: Threshold (characters)
threshold.description: Tool outputs longer than this are filtered. About 4 characters make one token.

model.title: Filter model
model.description: Model alias or id that does the filtering.

mcp.title: Filter MCP tools
mcp.description: Also filter text results of MCP (connector) tools.

read.title: Filter whole-file reads (experimental)
read.description: Also filter Read of a whole large text file. Reads with offset/limit are never filtered.

readThreshold.title: Read threshold (characters)
readThreshold.description: Whole-file reads longer than this are filtered when Read filtering is on.

priceRatio.title: Filter price ratio
priceRatio.description: The filter model's price as a share of the main model's, used for the net figure in /sieve.
